name: Fen-Poacher's Yew
flavor: Silent draw wrapped in oiled otter-pelt.
inspect: Stripped from a border poacher who fed three Thornwick taverns on crown venison before the bridge wardens caught him.

name: Toll-Tower Prod
flavor: Horn-tipped limbs notched for bridge-post distance markers.
inspect: Issued to Redmarsh toll-marksmen who collected tariffs from forty paces across the dry salt-beds.

name: Bracken Wind-Reader
flavor: Sinew-backed limbs lacquered against coastal squalls.
inspect: Carried by Fen-Warden Hale through forty dust storms without a single warped nock or snapped string.

name: Harborwall Winch-Arbalest
flavor: Steel prod stamped with Oakhaven's customs anchor.
inspect: Spanned with a belt-hook to punch iron quarrels clean through smuggler hull-planks at low tide.

name: Ash-Draft Greatbow
flavor: Six-foot stave whose string hums in volcanic updrafts.
inspect: Strung with braided wire from the shattered beacons; arrows loosed from it scream like falling slag.

name: Peat-Sinker's Cowl
flavor: Dyed in bog-tannin to vanish against wet reeds.
inspect: Worn by Fenwick's night-runners who poled contraband past border pickets without rippling the water.

name: Salt-Viper Jerkin
flavor: Cured cobra-hide riveted with tarnished brass studs.
inspect: Stitched by Redmarsh skinners; viper venom beads harmlessly off its overlapping scales.

name: Gorse-Thorn Brigandine
flavor: Crimson canvas lined with spring-steel lames.
inspect: Favored by outriders who needed arrow-proof ribs without sacrificing speed on loose scree.

name: Cinder-Wing Mantle
flavor: Pebbled redglass hide that sheds sparks like rain.
inspect: Cut from a fallen drake on the Iron Coast cliffs; smells faintly of sulfur and wet ash.

name: Sovereign Wyrmscale
flavor: Iridescent scales bound with dried wyrm-sinew.
inspect: As light as boiled leather yet capable of turning aside a Dread Knight's halberd.

name: Sedge-Walker Treads
flavor: Soft elkhide soles that leave no print in wet clay.
inspect: Laced crosswise by Greywood trappers who stalked wolves across thin winter ice.

name: Cliff-Runner Striders
flavor: Wing-stamped boots light as dried gull feathers.
inspect: Enchanted in Oakhaven for dispatch runners outpacing coastal cavalry along narrow sea-cliffs.

name: Bowyers' Horn Bracer
flavor: Grooved ox-horn guard polished smooth by bowstrings.
inspect: Prevents string-slap during rapid volleys in freezing Border Fords sleet.

name: Vane's Whisper Grips
flavor: Pitch-dark kidskin with lead-weighted knuckles.
inspect: Issued to Baron Vane's night-scouts for scaling wet stone walls without a sound.

name: Assayer's Sight-Mask
flavor: Steeped ebon hide fitted with a smoked-quartz monocle.
inspect: Cuts desert salt-glare and volcanic ash haze, letting marksmen pick visor slits at max range.

name: Redrock Misericorde
flavor: Narrow off-hand blade built for finishing pinned foes.
inspect: Carried by Redmarsh archers when sand-raiders get past the snares into arm's reach.

name: Parish Probate Wand
flavor: Notched with forty-seven unpaid pauper-liens.
inspect: Whittled from a churchyard willow; still smells of damp tallow and wet ink.

name: Salt-Oath Yew Rod
flavor: Graveyard heartwood rubbed with sea-salt and ash.
inspect: Used by coastal scriptorium clerks to witness sailors' dying vows over open water.

name: Fossilized Lien Wand
flavor: A preserved bog-beetle gleams inside the resin knob.
inspect: Binds lingering spirits to their unfinished contracts until every hour of labor is repaid.

name: Ossuary Siphon Rod
flavor: Hexagonal quartz darkened by decades of incense soot.
inspect: Draws residual vigor from fallen combatants to mend fractured bone servants.

name: Warden's Seal-Wand
flavor: Inlaid with tarnished brass rings stamped with watch-numbers.
inspect: Carried by the First Watch arbiter who cataloged the frozen oaths beneath the Threshold.

name: Abbey Witness Staff
flavor: Charred at the tip from swinging iron censers.
inspect: Balanced for long marches along muddy border roads where unmarked graves outnumber milestones.

name: Gallows-Root Crozier
flavor: Coiled roots that tighten near spilled blood.
inspect: Cut from the Night Orchards above Oakhaven; murmurs the names of unburied soldiers.

name: Pauper-Roll Cassock
flavor: Threadbare black wool patched with grey linen.
inspect: Worn by Thornwick's lower-parish clerks during winter plague tallies.

name: Grounded Clerk's Habit
flavor: Loomed with fine copper threads to shed static.
inspect: Keeps mortuary scribes safe when auditing wardstone ruins during Redmarsh squalls.

name: Bitumen-Sealed Habit
flavor: Treated with funerary pitch to repel rot and vermin.
inspect: Taken from a Third-Dynasty crypt gallery where embalmers guarded rows of sealed jars.

name: Arbiter's Velvet Mantle
flavor: Heavy burgundy pile trimmed with ash-grey fur.
inspect: Worn by inheritance judges of the old pale who cross-examined dead testators in court.

name: Shroud of Unpaid Vows
flavor: Stitched with silver thread tracing forgotten constellations.
inspect: Arrows seem to hesitate before striking cloth woven for the Threshold's silent keepers.

name: Scriptorium Veil-Cowl
flavor: Folded ash-linen hood smelling of gall-ink and sage.
inspect: Muffles battlefield clamor so the wearer can hear quiet debts spoken from the dust.

name: Brass Probate Scales
flavor: Tarnished balance-pans suspended from a quartz beam.
inspect: Weighs every ounce of borrowed sinew against the blood owed in return.

name: Tide-Witness Mirror
flavor: Bone-framed silver disc corroded by harbor brine.
inspect: Reflects lingering spirits trapped along the Iron Coast reefs.

name: Bailiff's Knuckle-Seal
flavor: Carved from a yellow knuckle-bone stamped with a tax-mark.
inspect: Grows ice-cold whenever an enemy attempts to flee an unsettled contract.

name: Alder-Gate Cleaver
flavor: Notched edge ground bright on river flagstones.
inspect: Held the eastern abutment of Alder Bridge through three waves of gnoll shield-breakers.

name: Basalt-Splitter Maul
flavor: Iron-banded ash haft wedged with quarry steel.
inspect: Used by freed Deep Quarry miners to crack the kneecaps of stone sentinels.

name: Caldera Trench-Flamberge
flavor: Undulating blade darkened with forge-soot.
inspect: Vibrates violently against parrying pikes, tearing shields out of numb hands.

name: Gorrathul's Cistern-Blade
flavor: Square-tipped greatsword stamped with dry-well tallies.
inspect: Carried by Ironheart's gate-warden who starved a valley to guard empty silt.

name: Obsidian Dais Zweihander
flavor: Six feet of meteoric iron weeping banked ember.
inspect: Forged in Ironcamp's floor-fissures to cleave through Dread Knight plate.

name: Ravenwatch Bailey Pavise
flavor: Scorched oak planks bolted to meteoric slag.
inspect: Stopped forty arbalest bolts in a single morning without splitting a single iron strap.

name: Vok's Fissure-Plate
flavor: Rippled black steel quenched in volcanic brine.
inspect: Turns a veteran infantryman into a walking redoubt at the cost of every copper in his purse.

name: Greystone Parapet Helm
flavor: Dented nasal bar scarred by demonic catapult shrapnel.
inspect: Kept Captain Rowan breathing when the eastern curtain wall buckled under siege.

name: Expelled Fellow's Staff
flavor: Inlaid glyphs copied from corrupted plumbing diagrams.
inspect: Proves that state liturgy and basic thermodynamics obey the exact same pressure laws.

name: Thornwick Mint Focus
flavor: Ashwood shaft wound tight with galvanic copper wire.
inspect: Originally calibrated to test silver coins for clipping; works even better on plate armor.

name: Ruptured Spire Lens
flavor: Milky crystal core humming at teeth-rattling pitch.
inspect: Chipped from a Redmarsh climate wardstone before the blood-chanters cracked it open.

name: Black-Blockade Astrolabe
flavor: Salt-corroded brass rings turning toward southern straits.
inspect: Salvaged from Vesperion's burning flagship; points unerringly toward volcanic ley-vents.

name: Threshold Keystone Eye
flavor: Slit-pupiled gem floating inside blackened gold.
inspect: Reveals the pressure valves binding Crown and Ember before the final seal breaks.

name: Conclave Grounding Hat
flavor: Midnight felt lined with copper grounding wire.
inspect: Prevents static backfire when channeling Chain Lightning in coastal rainstorms.

name: High Assayer's Diadem
flavor: Interlocking silver crescents cradling a cold diamond.
inspect: Settles icy clarity behind the eyes even when ash-storms blot out the sky.

name: Insulated Assay Gloves
flavor: Crimson gloves stitched with grounded brass eyelets.
inspect: Keeps finger-joints from blistering when venting high-voltage arcs at close quarters.
